lines.text: Elihu says God is mighty, despises no one, and enthrones the righteous with kings.
Elihu says God drew Job from the jaws of distress, but now judgment due the wicked has seized him.
Elihu says God draws up water for rain, scatters lightning, and by these judges the nations and provides wine in abundance.
Elihu says the thunder is God's voice, and God tells the snow to fall and the gentle rain to pour.
Elihu says no one can gaze at the bright sun, and God comes out of the east in golden splendor.
